document_title: Robert S. Chew to Abraham Lincoln, Monday, April 08, 1861 (Report of meeting with Gov. Pickens)
author: Robert S. Chew
claims: The flag of the United States was flying over Fort Sumter.
Fort Sumter had not been attacked.
An attempt would be made to supply Fort Sumter with provisions only.
If the attempt to supply provisions was not resisted, no effort to throw in men, arms, or ammunition would be made, without further notice, or in case of an attack upon the Fort.
